selection_warning: The component profiles and their one-open combination were selected after 2023 discovery and 2024-2026 diagnostic inspection. This is prospective-only for data after 2026-06-26.
objective: Increase monthly coverage without using the -10 USD-price emergency stop of WATCH-029-A and WATCH-030-A. Every component uses a fixed stop between 3 and 5 USD-price.

COMP_DAY_LONG.mechanism: bullish inside-bar plus NR7 compression breakout with H1/H4 alignment
COMP_DAY_LONG.entry_quality: breakout at least 0.10 M15 ATR above the prior high and bullish body fraction at least 0.50

COMP_NIGHT_LONG.mechanism: bullish inside-bar plus NR7 compression breakout with H1/H4 alignment
COMP_NIGHT_LONG.entry_quality: breakout at least 0.10 M15 ATR above the prior high and bullish body fraction at least 0.50

ROLL20_NIGHT_LONG.mechanism: M15 sweeps the prior rolling 20-bar low by at least 0.30 ATR and closes back above it

BLOCK_SWEEP_SHORT.mechanism: completed MT5-server 07-13 range high is swept by at least 0.30 ATR and rejected with upper wick at least 0.15 and close in the lower 25 percent

execution.entry: exact M1 bid/ask-consistent open after the decision bar is closed

strong_cost_stress.scenario: spread 2x plus 0.10 USD-price entry and exit slippage

overlap_diagnostic.interpretation: Low overlap, but not zero. Internal component overlap is negligible except limited compression-versus-rolling proximity.

structural_stop_audit.reason: At 2026 volatility, chart-structural stops frequently exceeded 5 USD-price and removed most current events. The remaining structural-stop variants failed strong-cost stability. Fixed 3-5 USD-price stops were more stationary.

reference_union_with_WATCH_029_A_and_WAT.warning: Diagnostic registry-level union, not authoritative raw-event portfolio parity.

limitations: The lane itself lost money in April, May and June 2026-to-cutoff despite a positive 2026 aggregate.
Its historical edge is materially smaller than the high-confidence 4R candidates.
The component combination was formed after diagnostic inspection and is not untouched validation.
